settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Theme, layout, playlists, downloads, and feature toggles.
settings.language.tagline: Pick the language used across menus, modals, and Hermes replies.
settings.playlists.tagline: Add and manage Xtream Codes / M3U / Stalker sources.
settings.backups.body: Per-profile settings (voice preference, theme, layout) persist to localStorage automatically. Catalog and watch history are stored server-side per profile.
settings.backups.export_note: Export / import a portable backup file lands in W4 Phase 2 alongside the settings store API.
settings.theme.tagline: Pick a palette. System follows your OS setting.
settings.layout.tagline: Switch between the 8 layout shells (TiviMate, Netflix, Plex, Apple TV, Samsung, Mom Mode, Dave Power, Zero).
settings.features.catchup_tagline: Show the Catch-up tab (for playlists/providers that support TV archive).
settings.features.catchup_detail: Turning this off hides Catch-up from the top bar. Re-enable any time.
settings.features.trakt_tagline: Sync movie and episode playback progress with your Trakt account.
settings.features.trakt_detail: Account link + OAuth flow lands in W4 Phase 2 alongside the watch-history endpoint.
settings.features.multiscreen_tagline: Watch multiple channels at once with independent audio focus.
settings.features.multiscreen_detail: When off, Multiscreen stays hidden in the Live TV sidebar.
settings.features.lazy_guide_tagline: Reduce memory by only loading programme data for visible channels.
settings.features.lazy_guide_detail: If you notice missing guide data while scrolling quickly, try turning this off.
settings.features.tmdb_tagline: Fetch richer movie info (poster/backdrop, cast, recommendations) via TMDb.
settings.features.tmdb_detail: By default, movies use the catalog provider's built-in metadata only.
settings.features.tvmaze_tagline: Open a TVMaze details panel with posters, genres, and ratings from the Live EPG.
settings.features.tvmaze_detail: When off, the info button and TVMaze sidebar are hidden. Cached data remains offline.
settings.hotkeys.body: Built-in shortcuts. Remappable hotkeys arrive once the hotkey editor lands (Phase 2).
settings.hotkeys.arrows: Move focus across the catalog grid
settings.hotkeys.back: Cascade close: player → detail → modal → grid
settings.about.credit: Built for Sherri (Mom mode) and Dave. Design language inspired by IPTV Player Zero — no copied assets.
chatbot.greeting: Hi! I'm Hermes. Type a command or tap a Suggestion below. Try: show movies, mom mode, dark theme, show 4K.
chatbot.no_match_known: I didn't understand "{text}". Try "show movies", "show 4K", "mom mode", or "dark theme" — or tap a Suggestion below.
chatbot.no_match_generic: I didn't understand that. Try "show movies", "show 4K", "mom mode", or "dark theme" — or tap a Suggestion below.
chatbot.credentials_blocked: Credential input is not accepted. Please use the QR onboarding flow.
chatbot.network_error: Couldn't reach the server. Try again in a moment.
chatbot.network_error_short: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
voice.title: Choose {name}'s Voice
voice.subtitle: Tap 🔊 to hear a voice, then tap Use to keep it
voice.azure_warning: ⚠ Azure Speech is not configured on the server yet. Previews and save will return stubs until the operator wires up the subscription credentials.
voice.preview_unavailable: Voice preview unavailable — Azure Speech is not configured on the server.
download.review_hint: Review the size before starting this download.
download.queued_note: The download is queued. The actual byte stream lands in Phase 4 once the operator wires the muxer pipeline.
download.threadfin_hint: Operator: set THREADFIN_URL in the API .env and redeploy.
